newsitem.title: USA: Intimate Brands sees catalogue sales rising.
newsitem.headline: Intimate Brands sees catalogue sales rising.

text.p: Intimate Brands Inc said Wednesday that momentum is good going into the second quarter and that its Victoria's Secret catalogue sales could grow to eight percent for the full year.
The company reported first quarter earnings of $0.13 a share on revenues of $704 million, up from 1996 first quarter earnings of $0.10 a share and revenues of $586.2 million.

"We're very pleased to have ended the first quarter of 1997 with good momentum to carry us forward into the second quarter," chairman and chief executive Leslie Wexner said in a statement. "Our three biggest businesses all posted record profits for a first quarter."
The company said its Victoria's Secret stores had a 14 percent sales gain and benefited from the strong sales growth at Victoria's Secret Bath & Fragrance shops, a high margin business.

It said Bath & Body Works achieved a 60 percent sales gain, a 50 percent rise in operating income in the quarter and opened 46 stores in the quarter, which it said was "a good start" toward attaining the 200 or so new stores planned for 1997.
It said Victoria's Secret Catalogue recorded a sales increase of seven percent to $179.6 million. "It now appears catalogue sales could grow eight percent for 1997," a company release said.
